01  /  Executive Summary

What Singularity WPSEO Does

Singularity WPSEO is a governed WordPress SEO platform that connects a native WordPress plugin, a hosted controller, Google Search Console, rank tracking, protected SEO governance, and a ChatGPT App into one auditable workflow. The result is not simply an SEO plugin. It is an SEO control system: strategy, execution, verification, learning, and reporting in one loop.

The product is built for the reality of modern search: ranking is no longer only about titles and descriptions. Site owners now need technically clean pages, structured metadata, JSON-LD schema, clear entity signals, competitor-informed positioning, reliable analytics, visibility tracking, and AI-readable page context.

Singularity WPSEO brings those pieces together so SEO work can be planned, approved, applied, verified, measured, and rolled back from a single governed system.

WordPress Layer

Manages titles, descriptions, canonicals, robots directives, Open Graph and Twitter/X metadata, XML sitemaps, and JSON-LD schema natively inside WordPress.

Controller Layer

Coordinates authenticated site access, customer authorization, reports, visibility data, batch proposals, schema overrides, and rollback through a hosted Python service.

ChatGPT Layer

Gives authorized users a natural-language SEO operator to run audits, analyze competitors, propose safe updates, verify live output, and generate reports.

The system is designed around trust. The WordPress plugin does not contact the hosted controller on admin page load. A site administrator must explicitly connect Singularity WPSEO before any data leaves the site. Read-only requests are separated from stored operations, public-output writes, rollback, and quota-consuming rank refreshes.

02  /  The Problem

Why Field Management Isn't Enough

Most SEO plugins treat SEO as field management. They provide boxes for page titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, robots settings, and schema snippets, then leave the customer to decide what should go there.

That model breaks down for modern teams because SEO work now requires several disciplines operating in concert:

Technical Review

Page-level health signals, crawlability, schema validation, and structural correctness that field plugins don't evaluate.

Competitor Positioning

Keyword strategy informed by what competitors own versus where opportunity gaps exist in the SERP landscape.

Governed Approval

Clear separation between read-only review and live public changes, with proposal queues and rollback safety built in from day one.

Measurement Loop

Search Console and rank tracking tied directly to change history, so improvement can be measured against specific actions rather than ambient drift.

AI Governance

AI-assisted recommendations that operate within guardrails, never overreaching, repeating patterns, or making unsupported claims in live output.

Client Reporting

Structured baseline, competitive, monthly, and campaign reports that connect technical state to business results without inventing data.

The result of the old model is operational friction: agencies can generate recommendations but cannot apply them safely at scale. They can install analytics but cannot tie measurements back to SEO changes. They can use AI to write copy but without governance it can overreach or change live output without an audit trail.

Singularity WPSEO addresses this by treating SEO as an operating workflow instead of a collection of fields.

03  /  Product Overview

Four Layers, One System

Singularity WPSEO combines four main layers into a unified operating system:

  1. WordPress Plugin — Owns local SEO rendering and admin controls. The customer-site adapter and the local source of all public SEO output.
  2. Hosted Controller — Manages authenticated site operations and ChatGPT tools. Verifies customer installs, enforces ownership, and proxies governed reads and writes.
  3. ChatGPT App — Gives users a conversational SEO command surface for audits, proposals, verification, and reporting through natural language.
  4. Brain.md Learning Layer — A protected governance layer that improves strategic recommendations across the system while keeping proprietary methodology and customer data secure.

Full Capability Surface

Baseline SEO Reviews Managed-Page Registry Technical Health Snapshots Setup / Takeover Scans Competitor Keyword Strategy Governed Batch Proposals Batch Apply Schema JSON-LD Overrides Live Head Audits Rollback History Google Search Console SerpApi Rank Tracking Branded Reports Protected Governance WooCommerce SEO
04  /  Architecture

How the System Is Built

Singularity WPSEO is a two-part product: the WordPress plugin lives on the customer site, and the ChatGPT App operates through the hosted controller after the customer connects the site. The system flows from the customer's WordPress instance down through the hosted controller to the ChatGPT user-facing surface, with the Brain.md layer informing recommendations throughout.

WordPress / PHP Stack

The WordPress plugin is written in PHP and uses native WordPress APIs. The plugin is designed to remain local-first until the administrator connects hosted services.

  • Plugin activation and deactivation hooks
  • WordPress title filters and metadata rendering hooks
  • REST API routes with nonce-protected admin forms
  • Native XML sitemap support and virtual robots.txt output
  • WordPress admin notices, tabs, tables, forms, and buttons
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatibility declaration
  • WooCommerce readiness detection

The plugin starts generic customer installs in scan-first mode. It does not ship another customer's metadata as the active registry. It can inspect the current site, identify candidate pages, and then materialize a customer-specific managed registry after administrator approval.

Controller / Python Stack

The controller is a Python service built as an authenticated remote MCP server. It is designed for deployment through a hosted environment.

  • MCP tool registration and OAuth-aware request handling
  • Auth0/JWT validation paths and customer registry
  • WordPress REST client and Google Search Console routes
  • SerpApi client and capability/health metadata
  • Customer-safe tool descriptions and protected governance behavior
0.5.58-wpseo-consent-scopes

The controller is a resource server. It does not issue OAuth codes itself. It validates authenticated requests, resolves the authorized customer/site, and calls the connected WordPress site through the site's bridge credential. It must not expose OAuth client secrets, SerpApi keys, Google secrets, WordPress bridge tokens, raw logs, or full operating manuals.

05  /  Setup Flow

Consent-First Onboarding

The setup flow is intentionally consent-first. Nothing is sent to the hosted controller until an administrator explicitly chooses to connect.

  1. Install the WordPress Plugin — Upload and activate the Singularity WPSEO plugin ZIP through WordPress Plugins › Add New › Upload Plugin. After activation, the plugin appears under Singularity WPSEO in the admin menu.
  2. Review the Connect Tab — The plugin does not contact the hosted controller on first admin page load. The Connect tab explains exactly what will be sent before anything leaves the site.
  3. Consent to Hosted Connection — When the administrator chooses to connect, Singularity WPSEO sends the site URL, customer/site ID, WordPress REST endpoint URLs, and private bridge credential to the hosted controller. The bridge credential is provided via a Copy ChatGPT command button, not as visible raw text.
  4. Connect the ChatGPT App — Once the site is connected, the plugin provides a secure ChatGPT command. The user opens the Singularity WPSEO ChatGPT App, authenticates through OAuth, and submits the connection command to link the ChatGPT user to the authorized customer/site record.
  5. Configure Search Data — When the customer is ready to track visibility, they configure a Google Search Console property, ranking provider, ranking target domain, and up to three tracked keywords with a SerpApi daily search limit of three searches per customer/site.
06  /  Dashboard

Native WordPress Admin Interface

Singularity WPSEO uses a native WordPress admin dashboard with clearly organized tabs. The goal is to give site owners a plain-language starting point without making public SEO changes.

Overview

Summarizes hosted connection status, managed page count, technical health, proposal queue, visibility state, and next useful setup actions.

Connect

Handles hosted setup with explicit consent, connection URL, Copy ChatGPT command, and full disclosure of what is sent to the hosted controller.

Managed Pages

Lists the current page registry including page key, URL, title, meta description, canonical URL, robots preset, schema label, JSON-LD schema, and override state.

Reports

Baseline, competitive, monthly, and campaign report types. Explains technical health, page coverage, Search Console state, ranking state, change history, and next steps.

Visibility

Separates Google Search Console data (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) from SerpApi rank tracking data (keyword, rank, status, matched URL).

WooCommerce SEO

When WooCommerce is active, surfaces product and category readiness, Product and Offer schema readiness, and future governed batch proposals for product SEO.

Privacy & Advanced Tabs

The Privacy & External Services tab explains each connected external service, including the Singularity hosted controller, Google Search Console, and SerpApi: what data is sent, when it is sent, and what each service is used for. The Advanced tab is reserved for administrators and support, providing diagnostics while keeping public SEO changes governed and reversible.

07  /  API & Permission Model

Three-Tier Access Control

The WordPress REST API separates access into three practical tiers. The controller includes bridge scope handling through X-SMSEO-Bridge-Scope, which lets WordPress distinguish read, operate, and write/cost actions when the controller calls the site.

Tier Scope Covered Operations
Read Non-mutating stored data Status, capabilities, managed pages, page SEO reads, protected governance summary, technical health readback, stored visibility metrics, report list and fetch, proposal list and fetch, change history
Operate Stored operations without public SEO output changes Audit run, takeover scan, metrics snapshot, visibility snapshot, Search Console refresh
Write Public-output changes and governed mutation Setup config saves, visibility configuration, proposal creation/expiration, batch apply, adoption, rollback, schema JSON-LD override
08  /  Governed Batch Proposals

Propose, Review, Apply, Rollback

Singularity WPSEO is built around batch proposals rather than one-off silent edits. A batch proposal can cover multiple pages and multiple SEO fields. The proposal can be reviewed before apply, then applied as one controlled operation. Batch changes create rollback-capable change records. If a write needs to be undone, rollback targets the exact change ID.

Supported Proposal Areas

Title Description Open Graph Title Open Graph Description Twitter/X Title Twitter/X Description Canonical Robots Schema Label Schema JSON-LD
09  /  JSON-LD Schema & AI Discovery

Structured Data as a First-Class Citizen

Singularity WPSEO supports JSON-LD schema as a governed controlled field. Structured data gives search engines and AI systems clearer entity and page-purpose signals. Schema does not guarantee ranking or AI placement, but it helps make a page easier to classify, cite, and understand. Singularity WPSEO treats schema as part of the governed SEO surface, not as an afterthought.

  • Bundled registry schema rendering with schema label and JSON-LD fields
  • Schema aliases including schema_jsonld and schema_graph
  • Validation and normalization before saving
  • Batch proposal apply and rollback support
  • Live head audit verification to confirm schema is rendering in production
10  /  ChatGPT App Workflow

Natural-Language SEO Operations

The ChatGPT App is a natural-language control surface for authorized users. The customer installs the WordPress plugin, connects the site, opens the Singularity WPSEO ChatGPT App, signs in through OAuth, and uses the WordPress-generated secure connection command. This is not a developer integration path.

A standard launch workflow proceeds in twelve governed steps:

  1. Run a read-only launch verification
  2. Generate a baseline report
  3. Review managed pages and setup/takeover state
  4. Confirm Search Console and rank tracking state
  5. Pick or refine up to three launch keywords
  6. Save or review competitors
  7. Create one governed batch SEO proposal
  8. Review the proposal
  9. Apply after explicit approval
  10. Verify registry readback and live head output
  11. Monitor Search Console and rank movement
  12. Roll back exact change IDs when needed

The ChatGPT App instructions explicitly prohibit inventing next steps, applying changes during read-only checks, exposing protected manuals, or running rank refreshes casually.

11  /  Brain.md & the Learning Layer

An SEO System That Learns

Singularity WPSEO includes a protected SEO brain concept. In product language, this protected layer is referred to as Brain.md: a living strategy and learning layer that improves the quality of recommendations across the system.

Brain.md is not exposed through customer-facing tools. It is not included as a public WordPress package file, and it should not appear in ChatGPT responses, reports, screenshots, support tickets, or public documentation.

Its job is to help Singularity WPSEO learn from what happens across connected accounts:

Technical Patterns

Recurring technical SEO issues and schema patterns that produce cleaner live output across connected sites.

Metadata Signals

Successful metadata patterns correlated with Search Console movement and rank-tracking improvements.

Competitor Intelligence

Competitor strategy patterns and proposal outcomes that sharpen keyword and positioning recommendations over time.

Rollback Lessons

When rollbacks occur because changes were too aggressive, future batch proposals become more conservative around similar pages.

The learning model is designed to improve recommendations on the fly while keeping account-specific data protected. The system generalizes lessons into safer, sharper strategy patterns rather than exposing one customer's private SEO plan to another customer.

Learn globally.
Generalize safely.
Protect customer data.
Never expose the proprietary brain.

This is the difference between a static plugin and a learning SEO operating system. Singularity WPSEO does not simply apply fields and wait. It studies results, turns outcomes into protected strategy, and uses that knowledge to improve search and AI discovery recommendations across the platform.

12  /  Reporting

Measurement Without Invention

Singularity WPSEO supports four report types, each designed to combine technical state, managed coverage, visibility data, proposal history, and practical next steps.

Report Type Purpose
Baseline Initial technical health snapshot, managed page coverage, and first visibility state. Establishes the measurement baseline before changes are applied.
Competitive Competitor keyword review, positioning gaps, and strategy opportunities informed by SERP analysis and tracked competitor data.
Monthly Search Console traffic, rank movement, change history, and a narrative of what improved. Only claims improvement when measured data supports the claim.
Campaign Change history tied to specific proposals, before/after visibility data, and campaign-aware description and title performance analysis.

Reports should not claim ranking or traffic improvement until measured data supports the claim. The strongest reports combine technical health, ranking movement, Search Console traffic, change history, and a clear narrative of what improved.

13  /  Security & Privacy

Minimal Exposure by Design

Singularity WPSEO is designed to minimize data exposure. The product never asks customers to send passwords, OAuth secrets, API keys, bridge credentials, payment data, MFA codes, or unrelated WordPress data.

What the System Protects

  • Controller secrets and OAuth client secrets
  • SerpApi keys and Google secrets
  • WordPress bridge tokens and raw logs
  • Private registry storage and full internal operating manuals
  • Hidden prompts and proprietary SEO brain content

Customer-facing tools return protected governance summaries, not the full internal operating manual or Brain.md contents.

manual_redacted: true full_manual_exposed: false

What Singularity WPSEO Does Not Claim

Singularity WPSEO does not guarantee number-one rankings, traffic increases, revenue increases, AI answer placement, automatic legal compliance, Search Console rows on a new property, or competitor displacement without evidence.

It improves the workflow, technical foundation, metadata quality, schema clarity, measurement discipline, and decision loop. Rankings and visibility still depend on site quality, authority, content depth, competition, search demand, crawl behavior, and time.

14  /  Conclusion

Expert SEO Workflow. Governed Execution.

Singularity WPSEO is a governed SEO operating system for WordPress. It gives the site owner a native WordPress dashboard. It gives agencies and operators a controlled proposal/apply/rollback workflow. It gives ChatGPT an authenticated way to inspect, plan, verify, and report. It gives Search Console and rank tracking a place in the ongoing strategy loop. It gives structured data and AI discovery the same seriousness as traditional metadata.

Most importantly, Singularity WPSEO is designed to learn. Through Brain.md and protected governance, the platform can improve from cross-account outcomes while preserving customer privacy and proprietary methodology.

That combination is the core value: expert SEO workflow, governed execution, measurable feedback, protected learning, and AI-assisted operation from WordPress and ChatGPT.
